interpretation: This independently maintained product includes imported third-party implementation and documentation. A separate name does not imply exclusive original authorship.
retained/modified compares the recorded original Git blob with the project file at this audit; subsequent edits should update the ledger.
project_added means a new repository file, not ownership of any referenced scientific dataset, model, algorithm, or historical result.
Full expression matrices and model weights are fetched from their providers and are not bundled.
